## Requirements: Project-aware Session creation with Existing locations and Project maintenance

**User journey:** Select Project from Web Sidebar Projects or App Sessions → Projects and open its **standalone Project detail even when no Session exists**; optionally also reach it from contextual work. Then create a Session on an explicitly configured existing Agent+directory. Project is not split into `ExistingProject` or `ManagedProject`; a Project can declare both Existing Locations and image references. No new persistent `ProjectEnvironment` domain type is necessary. The user can still create a Session without selecting any Project.
**Scope split (2026-11-09):** the Managed EROFS/Sandbox creation path moved to #3062 because its dependencies (#3022, #3023, #3024, #2681) are not implemented. This Issue owns the Project declaration/maintenance UI and Existing-location creation, and does not claim Managed behavior.
**Dependencies:** Project definition #3021 (implemented in staging) and Session-owned Environment Binding #170.

### Product flow
0. **Project maintenance entry (revised 2026-11-09):** Web Sidebar Projects header and App Sessions Projects area expose `+` Create Project (name required; Git Source and Agent Location optional). Each Project row opens standalone details; `···` offers rename/settings and delete with a confirmation dialog. Details manage name, Git Source/ref, Existing Agent Locations, EROFS references/build, and new Session. Backend Project CRUD is #3021; delete only Project definition/references and preserves Sessions, user-owned directories and globally shared images. Project list/empty state works with zero Sessions.
1. **Navigation (revised 2026-11-09):** Web Sidebar shows a visible Projects section (below flat Session list, before service footer) with selectable Project rows; App Sessions layer shows Projects after Session history and before secondary Agents. Selecting a Project opens a standalone ProjectDetail main/pushed view, **without requiring a selected Session**. The Project is not an Agent parent and existing Sessions remain a flat navigation list. Collapse rail shows Projects count as passive summary with only Expand actionable. ProjectDetail shows Source, Existing Locations, shared EROFS artifacts and defaults; do not nest ProjectDetail inside Session-only WorkspaceShell.
2. **Existing:** pick configured Agent/location; use the host directory with the current Native Session path. No Sandbox or EROFS download required; offline Agent returns actionable error without destroying configuration.
3. **Managed (moved):** Managed EROFS/Sandbox creation is owned by #3062; it is not part of this Requirement's implementation or acceptance.
4. Project defaults (shell, ordered ENV Profile IDs, sandbox policy) are applied only as create-time suggestions: **Project defaults → chosen template (if one exists) → explicit request**. Session owns the realized Environment Binding/snapshot (#170) and runtime execution identity; Project template edits never mutate running Sessions.
5. Preserve the selected Agent id, workspace location and effective Session context in durable Session context. Session creation reports its truthful state and supports safe retries; Project metadata changes after create do not mutate the existing Session.
6. Web Projects is a **proposed extension** of current WebLayout/Sidebar, not a shipped control. ProjectDetail is a distinct main-region destination; App ProjectDetail is pushed from Sessions with exactly one host-owned Back/Header and returns to Sessions on Back. The currently selected Terminal/Session is preserved, but Project does not require a Session. Preserve focus/keyboard/touch/state. Prototype includes Existing, Managed, no Session, offline, cache miss, build/download failure, collision and return scenarios.

### Project maintenance prototype verification (2026-11-09)
- **Live interactive HTML:** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/project-session-3025/index.html
- **Pinned source:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/c6a1b0fe5695712603b1fd36ed83b0ce5652d840/project-session-3025
- **Trusted publish:** [Deploy / Public Pages #42501801927](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42501801927) succeeded; source SHA confirmed against public `prototypes/manifest.json` and published HTML.
- **Chromium regression:** [Ephemeral Task #42501806352](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42501806352) passed **41 browser assertions**, including name-only Project creation, multiple Projects, row menu rename/settings, delete cancel/confirm, preservation of old Session, Web Sidebar navigation, App 390 Project entry/Back, zero-Sessions Project access, Existing/Managed Session flows, 1024/1180 Web and 390 App CSS-pixel widths and zero page errors.
- **Archived evidence:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/task-results/runs/prototype-project-management-3025-20261109/42501806352-1/record.json
- **Limitation:** These are deterministic in-browser mock/Pages observations, **not** backend CRUD authorization, disk deletion safety, actual EROFS Mount or production pixel-parity Acceptance. Earlier prototype SHA/browser runs are superseded by this revision.

### Boundaries and prerequisites
- Session lifecycle still owns Session creation/cleanup and tmux identity, not Project or EROFS Manager. Sandbox remains a single on-demand `SandboxExecution` per #2681; do not promise all later tmux panes/windows are enforced until that is separately proven.
- Server orchestrates and authenticates creation; Agent reports actual capabilities and cache/readiness; sandbox refuses missing mounts/policies rather than degrading to Native.
- Preserve legacy Session create clients and no-Project flows; with new client versions, missing Project refs and outdated digests return explicit errors; no user-owned directory cleanup.
- Metadata change after create does not switch Session's EROFS lower or reapply new ENV defaults.
- Prototype is a **pre-implementation interactive design artifact**; must not be used as runtime/Acceptance proof.

### Non-goals
No auto scheduler, no remote Project directory synchronization, no mandatory Git Worktree management, no editable Project Environment object, no new global capability lobby, no automatic dynamic image refresh of live Sessions, no full-container orchestration.

### Prototype
- **Decision:** Required — new two-path Project→Session flow with asynchronous build/download and Web/App return/failure semantics.
- **Reason / UI decision:** Projects are directly listed in Web Sidebar and App Sessions; selecting opens independent ProjectDetail (also without a Session). The remaining design question is the exact Project detail presentation and how creation returns to Terminal without losing Session continuity.
- **Scenario:** Web Sidebar / App Sessions → Projects (+ create name-only, select, row ··· rename/delete confirmation) → standalone ProjectDetail → configure Source/Location/EROFS → create Existing/Managed Session → Terminal; verify absent Source/Location, no Sessions, Back and fault/retry at Web/App widths.
- **Status:** Project management mock published and browser-verified at immutable `c6a1b0fe5695712603b1fd36ed83b0ce5652d840` (41 assertions; production backend and pixel-parity Acceptance remain Pending).
- **Direct interactive HTML (verified):** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/project-session-3025/index.html
- **Immutable source:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/c6a1b0fe5695712603b1fd36ed83b0ce5652d840/project-session-3025
- **Mock walkthrough:** Projects + Create, name-only valid input, multiple-project selection, row ··· rename/settings and delete confirmation/cancel (existing Session preserved); detail Source/Location configuration and EROFS Build, Existing/Managed creation, fault/retry, App Back, no-Session scenario.
- **Baseline / limitations:** Compared current WebLayout/Sidebar and AppLayers/AppSessions, Project detail is a **candidate new main-region/pushed destination**, not Session-scoped WorkspaceShell. No extra global shell/duplicate App PageHeader. Published Chromium interactions verified; real React fixture pixel parity and production functionality remain unverified.
- **Current publication:** [Deploy / Public Pages #42500374673](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42500374673) succeeded; public manifest/source pin verified at `c6a1b0fe5695712603b1fd36ed83b0ce5652d840`.
- **Current browser verification:** [Task #42500395005](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42500395005) passed 30 real Chromium checks (Web Projects Sidebar → independent detail, App Sessions → Project → Back, Existing/Managed creation, empty Sessions Project entry, 1180/1024/390/375 pixel widths, collapsed rail, failing download recovery, zero page errors).
- **Archived observation:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/task-results/runs/prototype-project-sidebar-final-3025-20261109/42500395005-1/record.json
- **Evidence boundary:** mock click-through / public publication only; no real Project API, EROFS build/cache/mount, production E2E Acceptance, or React fixture pixel-parity proof.
- **Fidelity:** mock interaction only; independent live Server/Agent/Sandbox Case required.

### Verification mapping
SC-01 → SCN-03: existing Agent/tmux Session create on an isolated native runner with rollback/legacy create; SC-03 → SCN-01: Session defaults/materialization contract and deterministic conflict/revision negative tests; SC-04/07/08 → SCN-02: Chromium Playwright Web Sidebar Projects + App Sessions Projects → standalone detail, empty Session, Back, keyboard/touch, status transitions, native Session preservation and regressions; SC-06 → SCN-08: prototype version, HTML/gallery/Pages exact-source readback. Managed SCs moved to #3062. No claims about actual deployed K8s or native macOS policy equivalence.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 An Existing location can create/attach a normal Session using its selected Agent and directory, with optional project_id; old clients and no-Project Sessions behave unchanged and missing/offline Agent state is explicit.
- [x] SC-03 Session creation applies Project/template/user override precedence deterministically; effective ordered ENV profile binding is Session-owned and a later Project edit never silently changes existing Session ENV, source version or mounts.
- [x] SC-04 Web Sidebar and App Sessions layer show selectable Projects; opening a Project enters independent ProjectDetail with Source, Locations, EROFS and Existing/Managed create operations, maintaining accessible loading, error, retry and return flows without adding a Project parent over flat Sessions.
- [x] SC-06 A clickable high-fidelity Project/Session Web+App prototype with current shell ancestry, standalone detail and scenarios/embedded UI Spec is pinned to a verified immutable published Pages HTML revision before UX is declared reviewed.
- [x] SC-07 With **zero Sessions**, Web/App still expose Projects and can open ProjectDetail to create a first Session; App Back returns to Sessions, Web returns to previous active Session if any, and opening/closing ProjectDetail never kills or resets a preexisting Terminal.
- [x] SC-08 Web Sidebar and App Sessions Projects expose + Create (name-only allowed), multiple-project navigation, row ··· Rename/Settings/Delete, confirmation with no implicit deletion of Sessions/Agent paths/global EROFS, and a standalone Project detail for Source/Location/image operations.

## Product alignment

- [x] Project is a first-class selectable resource in Sidebar; Session remains the primary active work entry and flat list, not a child of Project.
- [x] Existing Workspace and Agent visibility doctrine remains intact.
- [x] Web/App share semantic operations but respect their independent navigation and responsive patterns.
- [x] EROFS build/store/cache and Sandbox isolation have one canonical owner each.
